long: Serious Sam: The Second Encounter is a 2002 first-person shooter that continues the series' fast-paced, horde-driven combat. It adds new weapons, enemies, and environments spanning Mesoamerican, Mesopotamian, and medieval European settings. Like its predecessor, it supports cooperative multiplayer over LAN and online.
name: Serious Sam: The Second Encounter
short: Serious Sam: The Second Encounter (Croteam 2002, retail v1.07, via Proton)
